title: A compiled layer over a ground for each pixel; a path that works out its dense points once
description: fusain made its drawings faster by working round murex in two places: its own compiled copy of km_layer for a layer over a ground that differs per pixel (km_depth, km_over), and a Path subclass that keeps its dense points (_Dense). Both belong here. km_layer hands a batch of plain float64 layers, over one ground or a ground for each, to compiled kernels (and takes out=, which may be the ground); a Path keeps its dense points until its control points change, and the dense points of a CatmullRom, the arc lengths and the tangents are compiled. Not a breaking change: every result is what 0.1.1 gave, to the bit, which tests/test_exact.py checks against the code of 0.1.1.
close_reason: Done. A layer over a ground per pixel on 1120x820: 790-830 ms in numpy, 147-152 ms compiled (fusain's own copy: 153). A short stroke's path made, sampled and asked its length: 248 us, now 24 us. Bit for bit against the code of 0.1.1 (tests/test_exact.py; numpy 1.24, 1.26, 2.0, 2.4, 2.5) and fusain's thorough fingerprint (325 drawings), with fusain as it is and with fusain calling murex instead of its copies. oilpaint was not run: it is not on murex yet (murex-ant), and its tools/bench.py --compare must be run when it moves.

title: Use murex in fusain

title: Release murex 0.1.0 on PyPI
description: fusain and oilpaint can only be published depending on murex once murex is on PyPI. Human steps first: pending trusted publisher on PyPI (project murex, owner joce, repo murex, workflow publish.yml, environment pypi) and the pypi environment on GitHub. See RELEASING.md.
close_reason: 0.1.1 is on PyPI (0.1.0 could not be used: an earlier, unrelated murex had taken that version)

title: Move oilpaint onto murex
description: Waits until the work in progress on oilpaint is done. Replace oilpaint's spectral, spline, noise, png, reference and _filters by imports from murex, keeping oilpaint.spectral and the other public names working. Paint becomes a murex Pigment plus body (Paint.mix, from_optics and pickles of older paints need care). oilpaint uses these private names of spectral: _build_spectrum_to_rgb, _km_layer_batch, _layer_over_white, and its tests read _BASIS, _CIE_1931, _CIE_WL, _D65_SPD, _D65_WHITE_XYZ, _RGB_TO_XYZ, _XYZ_TO_LINEAR_SRGB: make public here what oilpaint needs. tools/bench.py --compare must stay identical on all scenes. Needs a murex release on PyPI first.

title: Set up murex with the modules oilpaint and fusain share
description: Scaffolding as in fusain. spectral, spline, noise, png and reference copied from oilpaint main (cd49cd9) as they are; _filters as filters with public names; Pigment is oilpaint's Paint without body.
